title: Mass Air Flow Circuit Low Input

common_causes.label: Air intake restriction upstream of MAF

characteristic_signatures.maf_contamination: MAF reads consistently low with erratic spikes; contamination often from PCV oil vapor or dirty air filter; trims compensate proportionally.
characteristic_signatures.maf_electrical_fault: MAF signal may drop to zero or exhibit intermittent dropouts; correlated with electrical noise.
characteristic_signatures.maf_ground_fault: MAF reading offset by a constant; all readings shifted uniformly.
characteristic_signatures.air_intake_restrict: MAF reads low but smoothly; restriction upstream causes uniform under-reporting without spikes.
characteristic_signatures.ecu_fault: MAF input circuit voltage out of spec; other sensors may also be affected.

available_tests.label: Smoke machine intake test for vacuum leaks
